title: Planning history
responsibility: Read commit metadata and classify changes to a single plan folder.

inputs.name: commits.git
inputs.description: Repository handle with root, Git directory and command runner.

inputs.name: commits.rev
inputs.description: Revision from which to list history.

inputs.name: revisionInfo.git
inputs.description: Repository handle with root, Git directory and command runner.

inputs.name: revisionInfo.requested
inputs.description: Requested branch, tag or commit; omitted means HEAD.

inputs.name: planHistory.git
inputs.description: Repository handle with root, Git directory and command runner.

inputs.name: planHistory.input
inputs.type: { unitId: string; revision?: string; limit?: number }
inputs.description: Unit ID, optional revision and limit from 1 to 500; history limit defaults to 100.

outputs.name: commits
outputs.description: Commit records with parents, author, commit time and subject.

outputs.name: revisionInfo
outputs.description: Resolved commit and metadata, original request, whether it equals HEAD and current branch when applicable.

outputs.name: planHistory
outputs.description: Unit ID, resolved revision and newest-first history entries with classified plan, design, approval, thread and message events.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Rejects invalid limits, unresolved revisions and unavailable plans; underlying Git and artifact errors propagate.
